about: Rimeforge Depths (pack-rimeforge): a frost-giants' smithy swallowed by a glacier, its forges still smouldering in the ice. Tall forge-naves, 8 m storeys on a 4 m grid, doorways 4 x 6 m. Walls: a black fortress-stone plinth to 3 m with faceted glacier ice above; black iron (flametal) ribs and beams; iron-bar portcullises; ember light against the ice's pale blue. The Ashlands stone and flametal are always mixed with the ice and the smithy's pieces so no room reads as the Charred Fortress. Builders: authoring/themes/rimeforge.py.
